title: Trend in Number of Artificial Intelligence Voice-cloning Scams
what_it_is: Trend in Number of Artificial Intelligence Voice-cloning Scams

sections.label: Scam lines and SIM limits
sections.summary: SPF has not tracked voice-cloning scam cases; in 2023 over 9,200 mobile and 29,200 WhatsApp lines were submitted for termination, and IMDA will limit post-paid SIM cards per subscriber.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Singapore Police Force (SPF), has not been tracking the number of such cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: While we have received some reports, where the complainants had alleged that voice-cloning techniques were used by the scammers, the number is not high.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In 2023, more than 9,200 mobile lines and more than 29,200 WhatsApp lines, which were believed to be used in scams, were submitted for termination.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In addition, the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) will soon be imposing limits on the number of post-paid SIM cards per subscriber.

sections.label: Verify calls and messages
sections.summary: When a call or message asks for personal information, banking credentials or money transfers, always check and verify separately, even if the other party sounds familiar.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: When receiving a phone call or message asking for your personal information, banking credentials or for money transfers, always check and verify separately, even if the other party sounds like someone you know.

sections.label: Deepfake detection and online safety centre
sections.summary: HTX is developing AI detection methods for video and audio deepfakes including voice-cloning, and a Centre for Advanced Technologies in Online Safety will launch in the first half of this year.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: For example, the Home Team Science and Technology Agency (HTX) has been developing detection methods for both video and audio deepfakes using artificial intelligence, including the capability to detect voice-cloning.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: In addition, the Ministry of Communications and Information and Agency for Science, Technology and Research will officially launch the Centre for Advanced Technologies in Online Safety in the first half of this year.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The centre will be a platform to bring together our community of research partners, companies and practitioners in Singapore to build capabilities for a safer Internet.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Such capabilities may include tools and measures to detect harmful content, such as deepfakes and non-factual claims, inject watermarks or trace the origin of digital content and empower vulnerable groups with resources to verify information they encounter online.
